import math

# 1979 monthly yields (from treasury_bulletin_1985_03_page_48.txt)
# Columns: Treasury bonds | New Aa corporate bonds
treasury_1979 = [8.98, 9.03, 9.08, 9.12, 9.21, 8.91, 8.92, 8.97, 9.21, 9.99, 10.37, 10.18]
corporate_1979 = [9.47, 9.52, 9.65, 9.69, 9.82, 9.51, 9.47, 9.57, 9.87, 11.17, 11.52, 11.30]

# 1984 monthly yields (from treasury_bulletin_1985_03_page_48.txt)
treasury_1984 = [11.82, 12.00, 12.45, 12.65, 13.43, 13.54, 13.36, 12.71, 12.42, 12.04, 11.66, 11.64]
corporate_1984 = [12.65, 12.80, 13.36, 13.64, 14.41, 14.49, 14.25, 13.54, 13.37, 13.02, 12.40, 12.47]

def pearson_correlation(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    mean_x = sum(x) / n
    mean_y = sum(y) / n
    
    # Calculate covariance
    covariance = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n)) / (n - 1)
    
    # Calculate standard deviations
    std_x = math.sqrt(sum((x[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n)) / (n - 1))
    std_y = math.sqrt(sum((y[i] - mean_y) ** 2 for i in range(n)) / (n - 1))
    
    # Pearson correlation
    r = covariance / (std_x * std_y)
    return r

r_1979 = pearson_correlation(treasury_1979, corporate_1979)
r_1984 = pearson_correlation(treasury_1984, corporate_1984)

print(f"1979 Pearson correlation: {r_1979}")
print(f"1984 Pearson correlation: {r_1984}")

abs_diff = abs(r_1979 - r_1984)
print(f"Absolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Rounded to 4 decimal places: {abs_diff:.4f}")
EOF
